t: The Sylvania RefLed Superia GU10 LED light bulb delivers 580 lumens of bright light with only 6W power consumption, making it an energy-efficient replacement for halogen lamps. This dimmable GU10 lamp provides a familiar look and feel, suitable for various domestic and commercial installations including kitchens, showrooms, and retail spaces. High colour rendering index of 90, ensuring accurate colour perception. Designed for longevity, the bulb boasts a 25,000-hour lifetime and high switching cycles.
